subject.title: Design: run lifecycle reliability — bounded liveness, abort⇒release, crash resume, completion drive

question: Should maintainers adopt this issue as the canonical staged run-lifecycle reliability umbrella and sequence Track A through Track D from it?
rationale: The source evidence supports the problem class, but the solution chooses cross-cutting lifecycle ownership, liveness policy, persistence, Codex-wrapper behavior, and terminal messaging boundaries that require maintainer sequencing.

options.title: Adopt Staged Umbrella
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical design packet and land Track A-D through focused PRs with proof against the listed invariants.

options.title: Approve Only Active Tracks
options.body: Keep the umbrella open but approve only the current Track A and Track B draft PRs while deferring durability and completion-drive decisions.

options.title: Keep Reports Separate
options.body: Decline the umbrella structure and continue tracking each production failure through narrower existing issues and PRs.

recommendation.title: Adopt Staged Umbrella
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the canonical design packet and land Track A-D through focused PRs with proof against the listed invariants.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus authored and self-assigned the umbrella and opened the linked Track A/B implementation PRs, making them the clearest owner for the sequencing question.
